facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The frog came inside. He ate with the princess. She started to like him. The frog helped her.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The frog entered the castle and sat at the dinner table. The princess did not like it at first. But the king reminded her about keeping promises. The frog helped her understand the meaning of kindness. He was polite and thankful for every small thing. Slowly, the princess started to feel warm toward the frog.
facts.Word cards: frog = 개구리 / helped = 도와줬다 / princess = 공주 / well = 우물
